name: Advertising Entity: Generic ads
project_description: Submodule of the Advertising Entity (ad_entity) project. It supplies a generic, provider-agnostic ad type as a skeleton for wiring up custom or arbitrary ad implementations. It defines an AdType plugin (id 'generic', 'Generic slot') and a JavaScript AdView plugin (id 'generic', 'Generic ads via JavaScript'). The view renders only an empty container div carrying the slot's id, an 'adtag' class, and a data-ad-format attribute; the actual ad is loaded client-side by developer-supplied load/remove handlers registered on window.adEntity.generic (see the ad_entity_generic_example submodule). Per-slot configuration is an identifier, a display format string, and optional default key-value targeting. A global option can additionally expose page-level targeting as a named global JavaScript variable (default dataLayer).
